items.reason: Inclusion: 'malignant glioma, World Health Organization (WHO) grade 4, including glioblastoma and astrocytoma'. Only grade 4 tumours are eligible and no IDH status is stated. Under §1.1/D27C, 'grade 4 astrocytoma' without an IDH requirement is the historical name for glioblastoma and counts as gbm_only. Listing astrocytoma separately could mean CNS5 IDH-mutant grade 4 astrocytoma (which would make it mixed), but the record does not say so.
